title: System Architecture & Design Philosophy
description: Foundational principles for designing modular, scalable, and forensic-ready agent systems. Focuses on 'De-complecting' complexity.

values.name: V8 Browser-of-Sorts Runtime
values.rule: Frame the Meta-Root as a V8-powered browser-of-sorts. Root modules (e.g., memory/public/) are localhost websites capable of HTML generation.
values.rationale: Leverages Node.js connectivity and V8 performance to transform repositories into interactive, addressable web-like entities.

values.name: Simplicity over Easiness (Hickey Principle)
values.rule: Prioritize objective simplicity (the absence of complexity/entanglement) over subjective easiness (familiarity). Actively 'de-complect' concerns to create systems that are easier to reason about.
values.rationale: Simple systems are auditable and resilient. Easy systems often hide hidden complexity that leads to technical debt.

values.name: Declarative/Imperative Duality
values.rule: Employ a dual approach. Imperative code is guided by metadeclarative comments within the same file.
values.rationale: Ensures that the 'Why' (declaration) is never separated from the 'What' (execution).

values.name: Unix Modularity
values.rule: Each script and JSON artifact should have a singular, clear purpose. Composition over monoliths.
values.rationale: The agent itself acts as the "pipe" between different tools and scripts, orchestrating complex workflows.

values.name: Boomerang Orchestration
values.rule: Agents must return to the user for steering after significant milestones or deviations.
values.rationale: The human-in-the-loop is the ultimate driver. The boomerang ensures session velocity remains aligned with strategic goals.

values.name: Fractal Memory
values.rule: Knowledge is structured hierarchically, from temporal logs to permanent Heartwood principles.
values.rationale: Monotonic growth ensures that every session turn contributes to the long-term wisdom of the firm.

values.name: Eukaryotic Repository Model
values.rule: Repositories are Subject-Object-Hybrid entities managed by MetaGit wrappers.
values.rationale: Distinguishing between git-managed logic and synced data layers ensures absolute forensic traceability.
values.description: Subject: Contains logical 'fruit' (json/py/md leaves). Object: Organizational passthroughs managing nested structures via .gitignore. Hybrid: Containers for nested subjects that also hold local subjects (e.g., memory/ - container + local comms).
